Skills associated with this job: Product Management, SQL, Agile, JIRA.

About Zomato:
Zomato is on a mission to ensure better food for more people.

The Role:
As an APM, you will partner with senior product leaders to conceptualize, define, and ship features that delight millions of food lovers daily.

What you will do:
• Define product requirements, PRDs, and user stories for core delivery and dining apps.
• Analyze user behavior, cohort retention, and operational metrics using SQL and Tableau.
• Work closely with cross-functional engineering, operations, and design teams.

Requirements:
• 0-2 years of work experience in product management, analytics, or consulting.
• Strong problem solving and analytical thinking skills.
• B.Tech or equivalent bachelor's degree from a reputed institution.
• Hands-on familiarity with SQL, Jira, and wireframing tools.
